We are looking for motivated employees who want to work as an order picker at Action in Zwaagdijk. 
Are you interested? Read on quick! 
As an order picker at Action you have a diverse function. You ensure that the right goods are ready for shipment in time and fully so that they can be brought to the branches by the drivers. You do this by collecting the articles that are passed on through the voicepick system. You will stack, pack, seal, label, sort and prepare the roll containers and place them on the correct dock. You also signal, register and correct deviations in outgoing orders. You drive around on a truck and you work with the latest technology. The voicepick system is available in Dutch, English or Polish. 
You work an average of 38 hours per week. There are two shifts: the first starts at 06:00 and the second starts at 15:00. End times are flexible. On Saturdays there is only a morning shift. On your first day you start at 14:00 PM. Action works with a clock pass. In addition, it is mandatory to wear work shoes as an order picker. 
 Job Requirements 
 - At least 18 years old - You speak Polish, Slovak, Czech or good English - Hands-on and accurate - Team player - You want to work for a longer period of time 
 Employment conditions 
 - Employment contract with Charlie works - Health Insurance - Possibility for organized accommodation - Organized transport to work - Weekly payments 
 The company where you will be working is a well-known retail chain: Action. 375 Action stores in the Netherlands and Belgium are supplied from this location. Action has six values that are important to them in the workplace: customer focus, cost awareness, teamwork, discipline, simplicity and respect.

 Your job in a nutshell 
As a Data Solution Engineer within the Store Sales & Finance domain, you will help Jumbo build a future-proof and robust data landscape. Using Azure, Databricks, Unity Catalog, PySpark, Python, and Power BI, you will develop data solutions that enable business teams to make better and faster decisions. - 
 What are we doing it for? 
You will join a multidisciplinary scrum team within the Analytics department at the Jumbo Tech Campus. Together with data engineers, analysts, product owners, and scrum masters, you will work on Jumbo's centralized cloud data platform. - 
 Your new team 
Jumbo's ambition is to be the most customer-centric retailer. Reliable data plays a crucial role in achieving that ambition. With your solutions, business teams will have access to the insights they need to make better decisions. By developing high-quality data pipelines and data products, you will directly contribute to the performance of our stores, financial processes, and the continued growth of a data-driven Jumbo. - 
 Who do you work with? 
You will work closely with data engineers, data analysts, consultants, product owners, scrum masters, and business stakeholders within Store Sales & Finance. You will also collaborate with other data teams to further develop shared standards, solutions, and best practices.
